## Scope and exclusions

## Acceptance and verification

- [ ] The agreed outcome can be demonstrated: describe how.
- [ ] Applicable checks have recorded results; list expected commands or review steps.
- [ ] Affected documentation and status distinguish proposed work from merged work.
- [ ] The owner can inspect the result and understands any limitations.

## Handoff
